errors.text_span: за да се оцени възможността на модела да репрезентира реалната цена на базовия актив
errors.evidence: This part of the description provides an interpretation of the chart's purpose, which goes beyond a factual description of what is visually represented. While likely correct, it is an inference about the author's intent.
The x-axis of the left chart ends on 15-Mar-22, not 15-May-22.

errors.text_span: с етикети, разположени приблизително на всеки два месеца (например 15-юни-21, 15-авг-21, 15-окт-21 и т.н.)
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis of the left chart are positioned every month (e.g., 15-Apr-21, 15-May-21, 15-Jun-21), not every two months.
The x-axis of the right chart does not go up to 259. The last labeled tick is 239, and the line ends at approximately day 250, as suggested by the title of the left chart ('за 250 дни').

errors.text_span: с етикети, разположени приблизително на всеки 10-20 единици (например 15, 19, 43, 57 и т.н.)
errors.evidence: The description of the tick intervals on the right chart's x-axis is incorrect. The intervals are consistently 14 units (e.g., 15-1=14, 29-15=14), and the example '19' is not a labeled tick on the axis.

errors.text_span: спад до около 60 през август-септември 2021 г
errors.evidence: In August-September 2021, the price drops to a local minimum of approximately 62, not 60. The drop to 60 never occurs in the chart.

errors.text_span: след което се спуска до около 70 през януари-февруари 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This description of the trend is incorrect. The price drops to a low of about 68 in early December 2021. By January-February 2022, the price is already rising sharply from approximately 80 to over 90.
The peak of ~125 is reached in early March 2022, just before the end of the chart's timeline. The chart does not extend to May 2022.

errors.text_span: които включват върхове около 110 и понижения до около 80 през индекс 90
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the right chart. The initial peak around index 71 is nearly 120, not 110. At index 90, the value is around 105, not 80.
The price at index 141 is approximately 75, not 60. The price does not reach 60 until around index 169.

errors.text_span: цената се възстановява и достига пик около 70 на индекс 180
errors.evidence: The chart shows no such recovery. After the sharp drop, the price reaches a low point of around 52-55 between indices 169 and 197. There is no peak of 70 at index 180; in fact, the value there is near the bottom of the trend.
The description incorrectly states the final index is 259, repeating an earlier error. The chart ends around index 250.
